title: Assembly Difficult
text: Assembly Difficult. Just once I would like to  say that putting something from China together was easy. Unfortunately this isn't it. Lousy diagrams.  Took three times longer than it should have.  Once it's together it is pretty sturdy, but not overly big. Maybe good enough for kids, but not that terrific for an adult.
